title: UAAP: Louie Alas savors ‘different’ energy in Ateneo-La Salle debut

blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo coach Louie Alas couldn’t push the Blue Eagles past La Salle in their UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball clash at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday night. Still, that didn’t take the smile off Alas’ face after experiencing his first Ateneo-La Salle rivalry game as a head coach. “Even back then I’ve been watching Ateneo-La Salle and this is the first time I coached in one,” Alas told the Inquirer. “The electricity is just different.
